fields.statement: At 35e6f758: re-ran the commit's Checks. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogPollOverrun exits 0, also under -race -count=5 with TestWatchdogPoll*. rhiza ship generate and rhiza render both exit 0. go vet and gofmt are clean. The diff touches only watchdog_pollbehind.go, its test, daemon.go and .rhiza records. watchPollOverrun arms a time.AfterFunc at PollBehind x interval. When it fires it logs one 'watchdog: poll still running after <limit>, in <project> <step>' line, using pollSteps' mutex-guarded running stack. Stop suppresses the line, and a disabled watchdog or pollBehind<1 arms nothing. daemon.go defers it around each poll and writes the line to stderr. The test blocks a step on a channel and asserts exactly one line naming 'rhiza watchdog' and 20ms before release. It also asserts no line within the limit and none when the check is disabled (Enabled=false or PollBehind=0). No stubs or TODOs.
